name: 02893 · West Warwick, RI
findings: ZIP 02893 (West Warwick) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02893 (West Warwick) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
